body.goal: Publish the completed experimental Watchtower Fold New Westside design inside the existing Doré Design editor/workspace so the user can inspect and edit it there.
requirements: Do not replace or mutate the production Westside homepage.
Add Watchtower Fold as an experimental New Westside page/workspace surface visible in the existing Doré Design editor.

Preserve its actual composition as faithfully as the editor model permits; if the current node model cannot faithfully represent it, add the smallest reusable editor capability needed rather than flattening it into a misleading approximation.
The design must be inspectable in the editor and remain editable, not merely linked as a static screenshot.
Verify editor load/render, page selection, editable elements, desktop composition visibility, and persistence without breaking existing Cover/Contents/Feature pages.
Repair any editor/runtime defect encountered and continue until the editor publication is verified PASS.
Return the exact editor page/surface name and canonical evidence.
body.pass_boundary: PASS requires Watchtower Fold visibly present and editable inside Doré Design editor with verification evidence. A source HTML file, screenshot, link, transport receipt, or production deployment alone is not PASS.
